verdict.rationale: Ramp documents funds/cards with restrictions on amount, interval, allowed merchant categories, allowed merchants and countries, and markets blocking risky merchants or categories and enforcing spend limits "all before spend happens." It also documents per-vendor limits on virtual cards and card/fund locking via MCP and the CLI. The pack shows how restrictions are set but not how a block happens at the point of sale. missing for 10: explicit documentation of point-of-sale decline/authorization behavior and of automatic locking triggered by policy violations, independent or hands-on corroboration.
